Title: Verify video playback: unplug and replug the HDMI cable
Preconditions: STB booted and playing a live channel
Steps: 1. STB booted and playing a live channel. 2. unplug and replug the HDMI cable. 3. Observe the video playback.
Expected result: The video playback behaves as expected, without: no video after reconnection.

Title: Check the absence of: no video after reconnection
Preconditions: STB booted and playing a live channel
Steps: 1. STB booted and playing a live channel. 2. unplug and replug the HDMI cable. 3. Observe the video playback.
Expected result: The video playback behaves as expected, without: no video after reconnection.
